claims.assertion: Swaruu dates the Federation's First Directive to 850,000–900,000 years ago, intended to prevent interference with less-developed civilizations.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She describes a half-million-race Federation, formed during the Great Expansion after Orion forces exterminated many species.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: The Directive restricts contact and advanced technology for cultures lacking interstellar travel or organized offworld ties; exceptions include contamination and external threats.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She calls it flexible guidance, breakable for greater good; contactors bear responsibility, while Federation and Orion Council supervise.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
